title: STORY COLLECTION: PRELUDING LIGHTS OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: PRELUDING LIGHTS OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Clearance Permits, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: Preluding Lights event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Clearance Permits from clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Trading Station. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
★★★★★: Bena, Bena's Token, Furniture Piece: Antique Display Cabinet, Information Fragments, LMD, Battle Records, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Intelligence. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Intelligence.
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Revolution Symphony", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Revolution Symphony", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting after in future update.
Operator Bena is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Preluding Lights. Operator Bena is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Carnelia, Kirara, Bena, and Indigo will gain more trust during this event.
